regime_context: China A-shares thematic rotation is led by AI Compute & Optics with strong trend scores; Semiconductors follow closely. Only 7 of 22 themes are eligible, concentration is modest. However, the absolute trend gate did not reduce drawdown historically on this market (gate_helps false), so the detector’s one validated edge is absent here. High unscheduled macro surprise share (0.69) adds noise. This note is experimental, low conviction, and strictly conditional on trend persistence.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the confirmed theme leader with a trending Hurst regime (durability 0.66, breadth 0.412), not crowded. The trend gate—despite having no historical drawdown-control edge in this market—currently signals eligibility. A low-conviction overweight is conditional on the trend remaining intact; the detector provides a focus lens, not a directional edge.
theses.dissent: The absolute trend gate failed to reduce drawdown in A-shares backtests; the leader could mean-revert sharply, especially with 69% of recent macro headlines being unscheduled surprises. The trend may be a false signal.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics score drops below 0.5 or loses eligibility, breaking the trend structure.

Like the leader, its overweight is conditional on trend persistence, given the gate’s unproven drawdown control in this market.
evidence: Challenger to AI Compute with margin 0.48
theses.dissent: The gate’s failure on A-shares history means the trend could whipsaw. Also, the macro backdrop (high unscheduled share) could trigger sector rotation away from tech cyclicals.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors score falls below 0.5 or durability breaks below 0.6, indicating trend deterioration.
